top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) covers the full, independently confirmed chain from GLP-1 physiology and the incretin effect to long-acting agonists with outcome benefit in diabetes, obesity and cardiorenal disease. The discernible change in medicine came when the short half-life of native GLP-1 was overcome, so protraction belongs in one citation with the physiology. P002 is a defensible basic-science trio, but Mojsov's priority relative to the Habener group cannot be settled from the supplied record, so I rank it second. No award is clearly worse given the maturity of this achievement.
